input.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import socket
s=socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX,socket.SOCK_STREAM)
s.connect('/tmp/gunicorn.sock')
s.sendall(b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: localhost\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n')
data=b''
while True:
    c=s.recv(4096)
    if not c: break
    data+=c
print(data.decode(errors='replace').splitlines()[-1])
EOF
sleep 5; supervisorctl status; echo "---alive---"; test -S /tmp/gunicorn.sock && echo "socket present"
